fields.localSourceHint: Uploads this machine's checkout to the server — for testing the installer without a published repo or registry.

imageMode.localHint: Needs Docker running here; images stream to the server over SSH. Works on small servers.
imageMode.serverHint: No local Docker needed, but the web build wants ~4 GB RAM (or swap) on the server.

hostKey.acknowledge: I know why this server's key changed and want to connect anyway.

sending.mtaHint: Mail hostnames ({outbound} for outbound, {returns} for returns) come from the domain you set below.

domain.label: Domain (for remote access)
domain.hint: Enter one domain — Owlat derives every hostname from it (app, API, mail).
domain.hintRemote: A remote server needs a domain so you can open it from this app after install — its own {localhost} is not reachable from here.
domain.hintLocal: Leave blank only when installing on this machine.
domain.noDomainWarning: Without a domain this install is only reachable on the server itself.
domain.publicIpLabel: Server's public IP (for the A records)
domain.publicIpHint: You connected by hostname. We try to read the server's public IP over the SSH session and fill it in here; if that's blank or wrong, paste it from your host's dashboard so the A records show a real, copyable address.

dns.enterDomain: Enter a domain above to see the records you need.
dns.enterDomainRemote: A remote server needs one to be reachable from this app.
dns.enterDomainLocal: Leave it blank for a local install on this machine (no DNS required).
dns.tlsHint: TLS certificates are issued automatically once these resolve — keep ports 80/443 open.
dns.deliverabilityHint: These get the app online. For deliverable email, finish SPF, DKIM and DMARC in {settings} after first sign-in — DKIM is generated there.
dns.spfMergedNote: SPF — merged with the existing SPF record at this host so your other mail provider keeps working. SPF allows at most 10 DNS lookups — double-check it stays within that limit. Confirm in Settings → Domains.

finishing.title: Finishing up — add your DNS records, then open your workspace
finishing.body: Owlat is installed at {url}, but the address can't be reached yet. Create the records below; once they resolve and TLS is issued, this turns into “Open workspace” automatically.
finishing.tlsHint: TLS is issued automatically once they resolve (ports 80/443 open).

loopback.title: Your server is running
loopback.body: It's installed at {url}, but that address only works on the server itself — not from this app. Re-run setup with a public domain to open it here.

secrets.notRemoved: Couldn't auto-remove the setup file. It holds your admin password and provider keys in plaintext — delete {file} from the install directory.
